text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score (the CRPS estimate, in points of capacity; 1 point is 1% of the series' effective capacity) over all leads. Demand: 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days. Solar and wind: 53 Tuesday runs. Validation year July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: mean over the seeds each arm has (three; monthly retraining has one). Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months.'
